data.name: Frank
data.message: Heading to navigation for Chart Course.

I found Diana’s body in electrical. My route was storage -> medbay -> electrical. I saw Eve in medbay around ticks 7-9, and I specifically saw Eve enter medbay from electrical at tick 7. Then I went into electrical and found Diana dead there. I didn’t see anyone else around. Not hard accusing yet, but Eve was coming from the body location and needs to explain.

I don’t have info on electrical directly. My route was navigation to security. I saw Frank enter navigation from security around tick 4, then later I was in security and saw Alice there around tick 6. I didn’t see Diana at all this round.

Bob’s report makes Eve worth hearing from, since coming from electrical right before the body is important. Frank and Alice were on the security/navigation side from what I saw, not near electrical at those times.

I need to address Bob's accusation directly. My route was security -> weapons -> cafeteria -> electrical -> medbay. Yes, I was in electrical briefly around tick 6, then moved to medbay. Here's the thing though — Diana was alive in electrical when I passed through. I saw her there at tick 6 and kept moving to medbay to start on tasks.

Bob, you say you saw me enter medbay from electrical at tick 7 — that's consistent with my route, I'm not denying it. But what I find interesting is that YOU then left medbay at tick 9 heading INTO electrical, and conveniently found the body. If Diana was killed right after I left, the killer had a window between tick 6 and whenever you "found" her. You were the one who went into electrical right before reporting.

I'm not hard accusing Bob yet either, but the reporter walking straight from medbay into the body room is just as suspicious as me having passed through earlier. Let's hear Frank and Alice — anyone who can confirm being near electrical between ticks 6 and 9 matters a lot here.

I can confirm part of Charlie’s story: my route was electrical -> security -> weapons, and I saw Charlie enter security from navigation at tick 6. So Charlie and I were both on the security side then, not in electrical after that.

I don’t have direct body info — I didn’t see Diana dead and I didn’t see the kill. The important window seems to be around tick 6 to 9. Eve admits she was in electrical with Diana alive around tick 6 and then left to medbay; Bob says he saw Eve come from electrical into medbay, then he went in and found the body.

So right now the main suspicion is between Eve and Bob unless Frank has info that places someone else near electrical. Eve is definitely the last confirmed person with Diana alive, but Bob also reported after going in. I want to hear Frank before deciding.

My route was weapons -> security -> navigation. I saw Eve enter weapons from security at tick 1, which matches the start of her route, and I saw Charlie in navigation around tick 4. I didn’t go near electrical or see Diana.

Putting the stories together: Charlie and Alice seem to confirm each other on the security/navigation side around tick 6, and I can confirm Charlie was away from electrical earlier. That leaves the main window in electrical between Eve and Bob.

Eve being in electrical with Diana alive and then leaving toward medbay is the strongest point against her, because Bob saw her come from that direction. Bob could technically have gone in and self-reported, but the cleaner opportunity is Eve leaving the body room right before the report. I’m leaning Eve here unless people think Bob’s timing is impossible.

I want to clarify the timing because it’s important: I was in medbay with Eve from ticks 7 through 9. I saw her come into medbay from electrical at tick 7. I did not see anyone else come out of electrical after that.

Then I went into electrical and immediately found Diana dead. So from my perspective, Eve is the last person I saw coming from the body room before the report. If Eve says Diana was alive when she left, then the only alternative is that I somehow killed instantly when I entered and self-reported, but that’s not what happened — I found the body as soon as I got there.

Alice and Charlie seem to vouch for each other being security side, and Frank says he was away too. That leaves Eve as the strongest suspect for me. I’m voting Eve unless someone has a much better explanation.

My info hasn’t changed: I was navigation -> security, saw Frank in navigation around tick 4, then Alice in security around tick 6. Alice confirms seeing me there too, and Frank’s route also keeps him away from electrical.

So I think Charlie/Alice/Frank are pretty clear of this kill based on locations. That leaves Bob and Eve.

Between those two, Eve is the one who admits being in electrical with Diana right before the body was found, then Bob saw her come out from that direction into medbay. Bob self-reporting is possible, but it would mean he left medbay, killed immediately in electrical, and reported, while Eve had just been alone with Diana there earlier. I think Eve is the stronger suspect here.

Look, I hear everyone leaning my way, but let me push back one more time because the logic isn't as tight as it sounds.

Bob's whole case rests on "I saw Eve come from electrical, then I went in and found the body." That's a reporter framing the narrative — of course he says he found it immediately. But here's what I actually witnessed: Bob left medbay at tick 9 heading into electrical, and the body call came right after. That's a self-report window.

As for "Diana was alive when I left" — yes, I passed through electrical at tick 6, she was working there, I moved on to medbay to do the medbay scan task. I was in medbay from tick 7 onward with Bob. If I had killed Diana at tick 6, why would I walk straight into a room with a witness (Bob) and sit there? That's the worst possible play. A killer leaves the area, doesn't park next to someone.

Also, Alice — you said your route was electrical -> security -> weapons. So YOU were in electrical earlier too. When exactly did you leave electrical? Because if you were there around tick 4-5, Diana could have been killed then and I just walked past a body I didn't notice, or she was alive and someone else came in after me.

I'm not going to convince everyone in one speech. But voting me out on "last seen in the room" when the reporter literally walked into the room right before reporting is thin. If I'm wrong, you lose nothing next round — but if you're wrong, you've burned a Goose.

Eve, to answer your question: I started in electrical, but I left before I saw Charlie in security at tick 6. My route was electrical -> security -> weapons. I didn’t see Diana dead, and I didn’t see anyone kill.

The key thing is: you yourself said Diana was alive in electrical when you were there around tick 6. That makes my earlier electrical visit less relevant, because according to your own info she was still alive after I’d already moved toward security. Charlie also saw/was seen with me on the security side at tick 6, so I don’t think I’m in that kill window.

So I agree the choice is basically Bob vs Eve. Bob self-report is possible, but the stronger evidence is still that Eve was the last person confirmed in electrical with Diana alive, then Bob saw Eve come out from electrical into medbay, then he found the body. The “I wouldn’t go sit with a witness” argument doesn’t clear you — that can also be used to look safe.

I’m leaning Eve here.

My info is the same: I was weapons -> security -> navigation. I saw Eve in weapons at tick 1 coming from security, and I saw Charlie in navigation around tick 4. I never went near electrical and didn’t see Diana.

At this point, I think Alice/Charlie/me are pretty removed from the electrical kill window based on everyone’s routes. Alice and Charlie also line up with each other around security, and Charlie saw me away from electrical too.

So it’s really Bob vs Eve. Bob self-report is possible, but Eve admits she was in electrical with Diana alive around tick 6, then Bob saw her come from electrical into medbay at tick 7, and then the body is found in electrical. That’s the strongest chain of evidence we have.

I’m still leaning Eve. If this is wrong, Bob is the obvious next person to look at, but for this vote I think Eve has the most opportunity.
